subject: Operationalization checklist & runbook transfer for ClearBridge observability
messages:
From: Claire Monroe <claire@clearbridge.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ops-eng@clearbridge.com, Samir Patel <samir@clearbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Observability handover — runbooks, dashboards, and cutover window

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We want to get the operational handover locked down before our pilot go-live window (targeting Nov 18–19). The three priorities for our ops team are: dashboards for key SLOs, tracing hooks to correlate requests across our services, and an error taxonomy that maps Redwood error classes to our incident severity levels.

Attached is our infra inventory (infra-inventory.xlsx) so your team can see cluster names and index prefixes. Can we get a short checklist or mutual action plan that lays out owners, deliverables, and a proposed schedule? Also we have a change-freeze on Nov 16 so anything needing config changes should be ready well before that.

Claire
Claire Monroe
Director, Site Reliability
ClearBridge Health

--
Note: forwarding infra inventory as requested.

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Monroe <claire@clearbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, ops-eng@clearbridge.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability handover — runbooks, dashboards, and cutover window

Hi Claire — thanks, got the inventory.

Quick read and proposal below. I attached two starter artifacts: "mutual-action-plan_v0.1.pdf" (high level milestones) and "observability-template-runbook.md" (a templated runbook we can import).

Proposed kickoff & cadence:
- Kickoff call: Thu Nov 5, 10:00am PT (30m) — sync owners and confirm SLOs
- Weekly check-ins: Tuesdays 11:00am PT until go-live
- Tabletop runbook rehearsal: week of Nov 15 (to validate alert routing and escalation)

Owners (initial):
- Dashboards & SLOs: Ben Carter (dash templates + Grafana panels)
- Alert routing & oncall steps: Laura Bennett (pager/playbook mapping)
- Tracing hooks & instrumentation checklist: Mina Haddad (traces + sampling)

Key deliverables and target dates:
1) Draft dashboards (SLO dashboard + error-rate panel) — ETA Nov 11
2) Draft runbook + error taxonomy mapping — ETA Nov 12
3) Alert routing draft (teams, escalation levels, notification channels) — ETA Nov 13
4) Tabletop rehearsal and final edits — Nov 15–16

Dependencies / asks from ClearBridge:
- Confirm final SLO definitions for latency and availability (we can use provisional numbers until Nov 9)
- Ensure we have read access to OpenSearch indices (naming prefixed in infra-inventory)

I opened a shared Drive folder (link below) and will add the kickoff agenda. If the Nov 5 slot works I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate the invite.

Mina
Mina Haddad
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: mutual-action-plan_v0.1.pdf, observability-template-runbook.md

> On Tue, Nov 3, 2026 at 12:05 PM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> > Quick read and proposal below. I attached two starter artifacts: "mutual-action-plan_v0.1.pdf" and "observability-template-runbook.md".

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Claire Monroe <claire@clearbridge.com>, ops-eng@clearbridge.com
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability handover — dashboards & SLOs (ownership)

Thanks Mina — I’ll take dashboards. Short checklist from my side and assumptions: 

Dashboard checklist (initial deliverable Nov 11):
- SLO overview dashboard (latency p50/p95/p99, availability, throughput)
- Error breakdown by service and by Redwood error class
- Tracing heatmap for high-latency flows (sampled spans)
- Team drill-down dashboards (for the two primary services)

Assumptions / questions:
- Index naming: infra-inventory shows prefixes cb-logs-prod and cb-traces-prod — confirm that’s correct so my queries can be templated.
- Grafana datasource: will ClearBridge provide a read-only datasource or should I export dashboards as JSON for your admin to import?

I attached a small starter file (sample-dashboards.json) with panel templates I plan to adapt. I’ll aim to have first-pass JSON by Nov 11 and a hosted preview link by Nov 12 if we have datasource access.

Ben Carter
Product Ops, Redwood Inference

> On Tue, Nov 3, 2026 at 12:05 PM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> > Quick read and proposal below. I attached two starter artifacts: "mutual-action-plan_v0.1.pdf" and "observability-template-runbook.md".

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Claire Monroe <claire@clearbridge.com>, ops-eng@clearbridge.com
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability handover — alerting & runbook fragments

Ben / Mina — I’ll own alert routing and the runbook playbook wiring. A couple of quick notes: 

- Error taxonomy: I’ll draft a mapping that ties Redwood error classes (e.g., TokenError, RateLimit, ModelExecError) to ClearBridge severity labels (P0/P1/P2). Initial draft ETA: Nov 12.
- Routing matrix: I’ll create a CSV that maps service -> escalation channel -> rotation (primary/secondary). Want to validate PagerDuty IDs and Slack channels by Nov 10.
- Tabletop rehearsal: happy to run the tabletop if we schedule 60 minutes the week of Nov 15 — I suggest Nov 16 10:00am PT.

Ben — if you can confirm index prefixes (cb-logs-prod / cb-traces-prod) I’ll bake those into alert rules. Mina — I’ll use the runbook template you attached and push a draft to the shared Drive.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Implementation Manager
Redwood Inference

> On Wed, Nov 4, 2026 at 9:30 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> > I attached a small starter file (sample-dashboards.json) with panel templates I plan to adapt.

From: Claire Monroe <claire@clearbridge.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, ops-eng@clearbridge.com
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability handover — runbooks, dashboards, and cutover window

Mina / team — this looks good, thanks for the clear plan. Nov 5 kickoff worked for us. A few confirmations: 

- Index prefixes are correct (cb-logs-prod, cb-traces-prod). I asked infra to grant read-only access to the dashboards team and we should have a datasource ready by Nov 8.
- We confirm the tabletop window: Nov 16, 10:00am PT. Please use our Confluence page for final runbook edits: https://confluence.clearbridge.com/ops/CB-3871-integration.
- Weekly checks on Tuesdays are fine — next one Nov 10 at 11:00am PT.

One ask: please include a brief section in the runbook describing a graceful degradation plan and a fallback model variant if inference latency spikes. That will be an important part of our change-freeze signoff.

Claire
Claire Monroe
Director, Site Reliability
ClearBridge Health

--
On Fri, Nov 6, 2026 at 09:30 AM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Thanks — we will add the graceful degradation section and include the fallback model variant notes. I’ll push updates to the shared Drive and send the calendar invites.
